description: This file defines a React functional component named `OfflineSubscription` that manages offline subscription activation and removal. It provides a UI for inputting an offline subscription code, handles form submission, communicates with application features for setting/removing the code, and displays relevant success/error messages.

methods.name: shouldShowOfflineSubscription
methods.description: Determines if the offline subscription UI should be shown based on application state.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionCodeSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the offline subscription code, sets success state or shows error alert.

methods.name: handleRemoveOfflineKey
methods.description: Removes the offline feature repository and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleRemoveClick
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog for removing offline key and triggers removal if confirmed.
